issue.title: SQL: Allow locally executed queries with count(*)

labels.name: Team:QL (Deprecated)
labels.description: Meta label for query languages team

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
This PR adds functionality that allows locally executed queries with COUNT(*). For example `select 1 having count(*) > 0;` In these scenarios `count(*)` should always return a size of `1`.

Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/37051.

issue.title: SQL: Support queries with HAVING over SELECT

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Handle queries with implicit GROUP BY where the aggregation is not in
the projection/SELECT but inside the filter/HAVING such as:

SELECT 1 FROM x HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

The engine now properly identifies the case

Fix #37051
